messages:
marta: Quick FYI — converting hf/falconx-16k -> redwood failed smoke eval, quality drop on chat tests.
alex: Repro steps?
marta: Used rwdx-convert then ran our smoke harness. Command I used:
```bash
rwdx-convert --hf hf/falconx-16k --out /tmp/rw/falconx-16k
cat /tmp/rw/falconx-16k/config.json | jq '.'
```
alex: What did jq show?
marta: Two glaring mismatches: rope_scaling object disappeared and sliding_window was coerced to an int. Also num_key_value_heads from HF ended up missing so converter defaulted to 8.
sreena: Wait — HF uses num_key_value_heads, we expect num_kv_heads, right? Which exact key was in the hf config?
marta: HF had "num_key_value_heads": 16. Converter looked for "num_kv_heads" and fell back to default. No error, silent fallback.
tim: Silent fallback -> silent shape mismatch at runtime?
marta: Exactly. Model ran but kv-cache shapes were wrong, so attention after ~4096 tokens degraded. We also noticed max_position_embeddings truncated to 4096 even though model config was 16384.
jordan: Why would max_position change during conversion?
marta: Because tokenizer.model_max_length existed (4096) and converter prioritized that over config.max_position_embeddings. Two sources of truth collided.
alex: Oof. Tokenizer special tokens also matter for chat templates, right?
marta: Yep. Tokenizer had special_tokens_map: {"bos_token":"<s>","eos_token":"</s>","additional_special_tokens":["<|system|>"]} and our chat template uses <|system|> as a system prefix. During conversion the additional_special_tokens were merged differently and token ids shifted, so template markers ended up in different ids.
sreena: So we had id shifts + wrong kv heads + wrong max pos. No wonder the chat eval diverged.
tim: Any stack traces or hard failures?
marta: No hard crash — inference path just produced context-truncated outputs and semantic drift. The smoke eval flagged sharp drop in turn-level BLEU and higher perplexity.
sreena: Quick mitigations?
marta: Pushed a patch to the converter to: prefer config.max_position_embeddings if present (warn otherwise), map HF synonyms (num_key_value_heads -> num_kv_heads), and preserve rope_scaling objects verbatim instead of flattening. Also added strict-mode to fail conversion on missing kv head fields.
tim: Did that fix the smoke test?
marta: Yes, smoke perplexity returned to baseline and chat templates lined up after we explicitly remapped special tokens and re-ran tokenizer.save_pretrained.
ci-bot: ci/build-2456: added unit tests for conversion keys: rope_scaling, num_key_value_heads, sliding_window, max_position_embeddings.
alex: Can we add an integration test that creates a deliberate kv-shape mismatch and asserts converter errors instead of silent fallback?
sreena: Agreed. I'll add a small-model fixture to eng-ml/convert-smoke and a test asserting explicit error message when synonyms missing. Opening PR now.
marta: Notes for handoff: 1) prefer model config over tokenizer.model_max_length; 2) map known synonyms for kv-heads; 3) keep rope_scaling as-is (object -> pass-through); 4) emit a clear warning with field diffs and suggestion to run converter --strict.
tim: Also adding a per-model "config drift" card to the Console so Ops can see on-boarding mismatches and SLA impact.
marta: cc @product — silent downgraded configs could affect onboarding SLAs and customer trust.
alex: :thumbsup
